blocks.title: Crystal lattice aur crystalline solid
blocks.text: Seh-jehti khala mein ions, atoms ya molecules ki ba-qaida tarteeb crystal lattice hai. Makhsoos, ba-qaida seh-jehti geometric shaklon wale solids crystalline solids hain, misal ke taur par heera (diamond), sodium chloride aur barf.

items: Geometrical shakal: har crystalline solid ki seh-jehti khala mein atoms, ions ya molecules ki makhsoos aur ba-tarteeb tarteeb ki wajah se makhsoos, numayan geometrical shakal hoti hai. Kisi crystal ke liye woh zawiye jin par sathein milti hain (interfacial angles) hamesha ek jaise hote hain chahe woh kisi bhi shakal mein ugaya jaye, aur madde ko bareek powder banane par bhi chehre aur zawiye makhsoos rehte hain.
Melting point: crystalline solids ke sharp melting points hain aur unhen in se pehchana ja sakta hai.

Cleavage planes: crystalline solids tootne par makhsoos planes ke saath toot-te hain, cleavage planes, jo kisi solid ke liye ek doosre se khas zawiye par jhuke hote hain; yeh zawiya ek solid se doosre mein badalta hai.

Crystal ugana: munasib solvent mein crystalline madde ka saturated ya supersaturated solution apne atoms, ions ya molecules tarteeb de kar usi qism ke crystals deta hai, crystals ki numo (growth) ke amal se, solvent ke aahista evaporation ya saturated solution mein seeding se. Sodium thiosulfate Na2S2O3 ki pani mein solubility 100 degrees C par 231 g fi 100 cm3 aur kamre ke darja hararat par 50 g fi 100 cm3 hai; 100 degrees C par saturated aur aahista thanda kiya solution koi crystal nahi ugata, kyunke supersaturated solution solid ke saath tawazun mein nahi, magar Na2S2O3 ka chhota crystal dalne par crystallization tezi se hoti hai.

Crystal ki aadat (habit): woh shakal jis mein crystal aam taur par ugta hai us ki habit hai. Agar ugane ke halaat qaim rakhe jayein to shakal hamesha wahi rehti hai; badalne par shakal badal sakti hai, misal ke taur par NaCl ka mukaab crystal us ke solution mein 10 feesad urea milawat ke taur par hone par sui jaisa ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Crystal ki habit se kya murad hai, aur sodium thiosulfate ke supersaturated solution ko crystallize hone se pehle seed crystal kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Habit woh makhsoos shakal hai jis mein crystal muqarrar halaat mein aam taur par ugta hai, jaise NaCl ke mukaab; milawatein ya badle halaat use badalte hain (10 feesad urea suiyan deta hai). Supersaturated solution apni equilibrium solubility se zyada solute rakhta hai magar solid ke saath tawazun mein nahi; us mein koi satah nahi jis par ba-tarteeb lattice shuru ho sake. Seed crystal woh saancha deta hai, aur izafi solute phir us par tezi se jamta hai.

items: Crystal lattice: ba-qaida 3D tarteeb; crystalline solids (heera, NaCl, barf) ki muqarrar interfacial zawiyon wali makhsoos shaklein, sharp melting points, muqarrar zawiyon par cleavage planes hain, saturated solutions se aahista evaporation ya seeding se ugte hain (Na2S2O3: 100 degrees C par 231 g fi 100 cm3, kamre ke darja hararat par 50), aur makhsoos habit rakhte hain (NaCl mukaab 10 feesad urea se suiyan).
